label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 046 ]

blocks.text: Touch is the first sense we develop, and we acquire it before birth. We could not live without it. Imagine being unable to sense the danger of hot water or to feel our way down a dark stairway. We tend to think of sight as our most important sense, yet we close our eyes in sleep for a third of each day. Touch never blinks, never turns off its awareness of the world around us.

readingSentences.english: Touch is the first sense we develop, and we acquire it before birth.
readingSentences.korean: 촉각은 우리가 개발하는 첫 번째 감각이다. 그리고 우리는 탄생전에 그것을 얻는다.

readingSentences.english: We could not live without it.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 그것 없이는 살수 없을 것이다.

readingSentences.korean: 뜨거운 물의 위험을 감지할수 없거나, 어두운 계단을 내려가는 것을 느낄수 없다고 상상해보아라.

readingSentences.english: We tend to think of sight as our most important sense, yet we close our eyes in sleep for a third of each day.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 시각을 우리의 가장 중요한 감각으로 보는 경향이 있다. 그러나, 우리는 매일의 3분의 1 동안 잠잘 때 우리의 눈을 감는다.

readingSentences.english: Touch never blinks, never turns off its awareness of the world around us.
